title: Portage Lake topobathy composite (as of January 2026)
region: Turnagain Arm and Prince William Sound
source: landslidescience.org composite: AK IfSAR, Anchorage 2015 lidar, Whittier topobathy lidar, Portage 2020 lidar (DGGS RDF 2024-7), Portage Lake sonar 2026-01-04 (Higman)
note: Revision-2 structure: every layer is a dated observation with a class raster and a sigma raster; masks come from state_rules (gate -> expected error -> winner), then despeckle + feather. No hand masks. Dates for IfSAR and Whittier are ASSUMED (see notes) - correct them. GRID: the five legacy crops' lattice (EPSG:32606, WGS 84 / UTM 6N as tagged by the crops, 1 m), stacked by pixel index; a re-gridded build from datasets.json sources would sit on NAD83(2011)/UTM 6N and differ by sub-pixel resampling.

layers.name: ifsar
layers.notes: date assumed (AK IfSAR 2010-2012); no water detection: not hydro-flattened at a precise level

layers.name: anc2015
layers.notes: spring 2015 flight with snow: survey-wide sigma 0.5 (snow prior) + snow_vs portage2020 classes the plainly snowy parts as snow (+1.5 m); newer snow-free lidars (Whittier 0.3, Portage 2020 0.1) replace it on land
